items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well I've heard of Ike and Al and Eddie and Sam and Andrew... [INTERVIEWEE] Morgan, no. He's not akin to the Morgan brothers at all, no, no, it was a different Morgan.

ctx.x: Yeah, I gotta go on. Yeah. I gotta go to work tonight. Well, boy, I'm such a fan and I hope...

Sam says, now, but I wanted to ask you, get back to what we were talking about, all the different things. Were you a regular man with Celestan, a regular member of his band? Did you play with him as a sub?

No, I played with him, you know how Celestan was. He kept a fellow a while, you know when he had jobs, you know what I'm saying? I worked with him a while and then after winding up, he wound up with Albert French.
